description: Check how close this program is to tracking real affiliate sales. Use it first to see what to fix, and after affitor_run_verification, every poll.retry_after_seconds until integration_verified is true. Returns state, integration_verified, blocker (the first failing gate), each gate (profile, economics, payout, tracking, live) with status and next_action, last event times and 24-hour counts.

forceRecheck.description: Run the checks again now, including a fetch of your site to find the tracker. Leave it out to get the last saved result, which is enough while polling.

name: affitor_readiness
